source:
---
config:
  theme: default
  look: classic
  layout: dagre
---
agentflow-beta TB
  brief["Release brief"]@{ shape: input }
  flow writer["Drafting Agent"]
    draft["Draft the notes"]@{ shape: task }
    lookup["changelog_search"]@{ shape: tool }
    guide["Tone of voice"]@{ shape: refdoc }
    draft --> lookup
    draft -.- guide
  end
  flow reviewer["Review Agent"]
    check["Check the claims"]@{ shape: task }
    ok["Accurate?"]@{ shape: decision }
    check --> ok
  end
  publish["Publish"]@{ shape: action }
  brief --> writer
  writer --> reviewer
  ok --> publish

    summarise -.- corpus
  end

  flow indexer["Indexer"]

    index -.- corpus
  end

---
config:
  theme: default
  look: classic
  layout: dagre
---
agentflow-beta TB
  brief["Release brief"]@{ shape: input }
  flow writer["Drafting Agent"]
    draft["Draft the notes"]@{ shape: task }
    lookup["changelog_search"]@{ shape: tool }
    guide["Tone of voice"]@{ shape: refdoc }
    draft --> lookup
    draft -.- guide
  end
  flow reviewer["Review Agent"]
    check["Check the claims"]@{ shape: task }
    ok["Accurate?"]@{ shape: decision }
    check --> ok
  end
  publish["Publish"]@{ shape: action }
  brief --> writer
  writer --> reviewer
  ok --> publish
